## In Class Activity

Work in groups of 2-3 with people not in your project groups.

We will go over the answers at 12:50.

Notes:

- When questions ask for \textit{estimated regression equation} it is asking for the formula you would use to calculate predicted values

- Standard Error for question 2 is in the parentheses under the estimate

- Make sure to note the units of variable when calculating estimated regression equation

- Constant is the same thing as Intercept
